notice: Major is an Administration-only appointment and is not part of standard training or promotional progression.

staff.title: Step 1 — Orientation
staff.exercise: Identify the escalation route and demonstrate secure handling of a fictional staff report.
staff.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

staff.title: Step 2 — Rules & Enforcement
staff.exercise: Review a fictional rule violation, identify the applicable draft rule, and explain when to recuse or escalate.
staff.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

staff.title: Step 3 — Tickets & Administrative Logs
staff.exercise: Produce a fictional ticket summary with timestamps, evidence references, and an outcome rationale.
staff.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

staff.title: Step 4 — Discipline
staff.exercise: Select a proposed response using [PENALTY STRUCTURE TBD]. Identify the approving role before taking action.
staff.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

staff.title: Step 5 — Scenario Training
staff.exercise: For each scenario: identify the issue, preserve context, state the escalation, and write a fictional action log.
staff.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

staff.title: Step 6 — Field Training
staff.exercise: Trainee shadows an FTO or approved supervisor, then handles assigned practice tasks with documented review.
staff.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

staff.title: Step 7 — Final Review
staff.exercise: Reviewer checks completed reports and unresolved deficiencies. Record the result; completion never grants Major.
staff.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

leo.title: Academy Orientation
leo.exercise: Locate the applicable server rules and confirm [UNIFORM REQUIREMENTS TBD] and [VEHICLE REQUIREMENTS TBD].
leo.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

leo.title: Radio Communications
leo.exercise: Practice: “[CALL SIGN TBD], traffic stop at [IN-GAME LOCATION], [VEHICLE DESCRIPTION], [BACKUP STATUS].” Use plain language until codes are adopted.
leo.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

leo.title: Traffic Stops
leo.exercise: Use these steps in order during a supervised in-game scenario. Checks and outcomes are fictional game interactions subject to server rules.
leo.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

leo.title: Calls for Service
leo.exercise: Simulate an in-game call, explain the roleplay situation, request assistance, and document the fictional outcome.
leo.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

leo.title: High-Risk Incidents
leo.exercise: In a controlled ER:LC scenario, communicate the game location, request a supervisor, coordinate player roles, and seek de-escalation. Pause or end RP if platform or server rules are breached. [PURSUIT RESTRICTIONS TBD]
leo.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

leo.title: Reports
leo.exercise: Write a factual fictional incident summary distinguishing observations from assumptions; attach only authorized references.
leo.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

leo.title: Field Training
leo.exercise: Complete an FTO report after each session, document deficiencies, and plan the next session. [TRAINING PHASES TBD]
leo.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]

leo.title: Final Evaluation
leo.exercise: Command reviews the documented evaluation. Major is excluded from all academy, FTO, testing, points, hours, and routine progression.
leo.completion: Trainer documents observation, coaching, and next step. [COMPLETION STANDARD TBD]
